lg - gram max 17\" 2.5k touch-screen lap.description: LG gram Max combines a thin, and lightweight design with serious AI performance for work and creativity on the go. Powered by Intel² Core Ultra 7 with AI-ready NPU (up to 49 TOPS) and Intel Graphics graphics, it handles demanding multitasking, creative workflows, and AI-driven tasks with ease. Dual AI combines On-Device and Cloud³ AI for fast search, summarization, and intelligent productivity. A 77Wh battery delivers up to 26.5 hours of video playback⁴. With Thunderbolt 4, HDMI, Dolby Atmos, advanced cooling, and Copilot+ PC capabilities, gram Max delivers premium power without the weight. LG's Dual AI solution combines On-Device AI and Cloud AI for intelligent productivity—summarize documents, search files naturally, recall past activity, and optimize workflows even offline. And as a Copilot+ PC, LG gram Max delivers advanced AI features. With dual Thunderbolt 4 ports, USB 3.2, HDMI, RTX graphics, Dolby Atmos, gram Link multi-device connectivity, and advanced cooling, the LG gram Max is built to move fast, stay light, and perform without limits.
